swat.name: Swat
swat.description: Negates the first hit it takes each round
swat.counter: Open with a cheap hit, then land the real one

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.counter: Kill or taunt it before your big spenders act

secondChance.name: Second Chance
secondChance.description: Once per battle, gets back up at 15% HP
secondChance.counter: Save burst for the second life

floorGeneral.name: Floor General
floorGeneral.description: Every other monster deals +2 damage while it lives

deepRange.name: Deep Range
deepRange.counter: Heal or shield whoever it targets

takeover.name: Takeover
takeover.description: Acts twice once below half HP
takeover.counter: Burst it from high HP to dead in one round

hotHand.name: Hot Hand
hotHand.description: +2 damage for each round it isn't hit (up to +6); any hit resets it
